exact_query: rows of mcxc_raw.tsv whose MCXC column is one of: J0014.3-3023, J0717.5+3745, J1149.5+2224, J1510.9+0543, J2248.7-4431
extraction: Exact subset of mcxc_raw.tsv - the 5 of the 7 target clusters that are present in the MCXC. Values copied verbatim. Raw catalogue kept alongside as mcxc_raw.tsv.
note: Global X-ray properties for 5 of the 7 target clusters. MCXC meta-catalogue (Piffaretti, Arnaud, Pratt, Pointecouteau, Melin 2011, A&A 534, A109). *** THIS IS A SCALING-RELATION PRODUCT, NOT A PROFILE AND NOT A TEMPERATURE MEASUREMENT *** The MCXC contains NO temperature column at all. L500 is a ROSAT-based 0.1-2.4 keV luminosity homogenised to an overdensity of 500; M500 and R500 are then obtained from L500 through the L-M scaling relation of Arnaud et al. (2010), which was itself calibrated on HYDROSTATIC masses. M500 and R500 must therefore be treated as derived, HSE-calibrated quantities, not observations. *** ABELL 370 AND MACS J0416.1-2403 ARE NOT IN THE MCXC *** - verified by inspecting every MCXC entry within a wide RA window of each target position (A370 at 02 39 53.1 -01 34 36; MACS J0416 at 04 16 08.4 -24 04 21); no MCXC entry lies at either position.
units_note: L500 in 1e37 W (= 1e44 erg/s), M500 in 1e14 Msun, R500 in Mpc, Scale in kpc/arcsec
